DEAD SIGNAL / FIELD MANUAL

READ. THEN RUN.

Get your people out alive. You command the highlighted soldier; the rest of the squad follows.

01

MOVE AS ONE

On a phone, drag the movement pad with your left thumb. Tap the field to order a move. On desktop, click or use WASD / arrow keys. Tap a squad portrait to change leader. Your order follows a route around cover; the coastline cannot be crossed.

02

MAKE SOME NOISE

The squad automatically shoots nearby targets. Stopping to fire improves accuracy. Gunfire brings zombies. Toggle Hold Fire to travel quietly. Enemy soldiers and zombies fight each other too.

03

BREAK THE DEADLOCK

Tap Grenade to throw toward the closest enemy, or in the direction your leader faces. On desktop, point and press G, or hold right-click to aim and fire. Blasts break huts and barrels; your squad is safe from its own grenades. Cover blocks bullets.

04

BRING THEM HOME

Reach the marked survivors, then get your squad to the green extraction circle. Mission three needs the remaining hostiles cleared. Bring all living soldiers and rescued survivors into the zone. Stay together until the extraction timer finishes.

EVERY NAME COUNTS.

Lost soldiers stay lost for that mission. Keep an eye on the squad’s health. You can restart, choose Recruit difficulty, or pause at any time.
